sentences.en: For defining media ethics advisably, we should firstly not to departure from the essentiality of ethics, hich we take as devoting itself to ultimate good.

sentences.en: Conclusions It is an important measure for preventing AIDS from dissemination to provide health education focuses on knowledge regarding AIDS timely, advisably and moderately.

sentences.en: Don't make promise when you are in joy. Don't reply when you are sad. Don't take decision when you are angry. Think twice, act advisably.
